editorial.blurb: SingSing brings authentic Thai street-food flavors with bold, aromatic dishes that transport you straight to Thailand.
editorial.insiderTip: Come with a group and bring your own wine (BYOB) to share multiple dishes family-style—the owner creates a lively, welcoming atmosphere and the portions are designed for sharing.

topDishes.note: Grilled to perfection, fatty and tasty with sweet and spicy sauce
Crispy, fresh, and slightly sweet—consistently praised
Authentically executed, evokes the feeling of eating in Chiang Mai
